tier1.text: The membrane surrounding a cell that separates the cell from its external environment. It consists of a phospholipid bilayer and associated proteins.
tier1.attribution: Definition from the Gene Ontology (GO 2026-07-26), GO:0005886. CC BY 4.0.

figures.title: Plasma membrane: ARHGAP19 immunofluorescence
figures.caption: Cultured human cells (U2OS) stained by immunofluorescence for the ARHGAP19 protein (green), which HPA locates only in the plasma membrane (reliability enhanced). Other colours are reference stains (blue: nucleus; red: microtubules).
figures.alt: Fluorescence microscope image of cells with ARHGAP19 protein in green, marking the plasma membrane.
figures.credit: Image from the Human Protein Atlas 25.1 (proteinatlas.org): Plasma membrane: ARHGAP19 immunofluorescence, https://images.proteinatlas.org/43231/494_A6_3_blue_red_green.jpg. CC BY 4.0.

figures.title: Cell Membrane
figures.caption: The cell membrane of the cell is a phospholipid bilayer containing many different molecular components, including proteins and cholesterol, some with carbohydrate groups attached.
figures.alt: This image shows a lipid bilayer with different types of proteins, lipids and cholesterol embedded in it.
figures.credit: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.
